newsitem.title: ISRAEL: British minister slams Jewish settlement building.
newsitem.headline: British minister slams Jewish settlement building.

text.p: Britain's Foreign Office minister on Tuesday visited the site in Arab East Jersualem where Israel is building a new Jewish settlement and said it was an obstacle to peace.
"We see the settlements as illegal," said Derek Fatchett, the first British minister to visit Israel since Britain's Labour party won general elections this month.
"This settlement is a roadblock in the peace process," he said from a hill overlooking Jabal Abu Ghneim where Israel is building 6,500 homes for Jews.

Israeli construction at the site launched in March plunged peacemaking into crisis. Palestinians say settlement building pre-empts final status peace talks at which the fate of Jerusalem is to be negotiated.
Fatchett's visit to the site, which Israeli calls Har Homa, coincided with an Egyptian-Israeli summit aimed at ending the deadlock in peacemaking.
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak said the meeting was a first step towards reviving talks but more meetingd were necessary.
Fatchett said Britain's policy in the Middle East would not change significantly under the Labour government, but that it would focus more on human rights.
"There will be an ethical dimension to Britain's foreign policy," he told reporters.
